requirement: A store's new WhatsApp number reaches its listings
expected: After the store changes its number, the WhatsApp button of every unsold store listing opens the new number; sold listings keep theirs.
preconditions: Verified store with approved and sold listings
steps: Change the store's WhatsApp in Mi tienda; open an approved listing and the sold one; inspect the wa.me links.

requirement: WhatsApp links open for numbers stored without +51
expected: A listing whose number is stored as 9 digits opens wa.me/51…; numbers already with 51 are unchanged.
preconditions: Listing whose number is stored as 9 digits
steps: Open the listing and press Contactar por WhatsApp.

requirement: A sold listing's similar link never lands on nothing
expected: On a sold listing with no similar public listings, Ver publicaciones similares scrolls to a line linking the catalog.
preconditions: Sold listing of a type with no other public listings
steps: Open it and press Ver publicaciones similares.

requirement: The payment limitation is said once, under the contact button
expected: The listing page shows "Laria no procesa pagos ni envíos · Cómo comprar seguro" under the button on every width; no separate trust block; the link opens the safety sheet.
steps: Open it at 390 and 1366 px; press Cómo comprar seguro.

requirement: Key specs read in one line
expected: Under the title, up to five specs joined by ·; yes attributes read as their label, no ones are left out.
steps: Open it.

requirement: Dates read like people talk
expected: Publicado hoy/ayer/hace N días/semanas/meses/años; Actualizado only after a later content change; the quiet note after 90 days untouched for 60.
steps: Open them; edit one's price and reopen.

requirement: A real price drop shows Antes for 30 days
expected: An approved listing whose price fell ≥5% from a price held ≥7 days shows Antes S/ old on the page and cards for 30 days; increases clear it; pending and sold listings never show it.
preconditions: Approved listing with a price held 7 days
steps: Lower the price 10%; open the page and the catalog; raise it.

requirement: Every review is reachable
expected: The reviews section shows the count per star and Ver las N reseñas loads the rest 20 at a time.
preconditions: Seller with more than five published reviews
steps: Open a listing; press Ver las N reseñas.

requirement: Similar listings rank brand, price, city
expected: Up to 8 in a scrollable row with buttons from 768 px; same brand first, then within 30% of the price, then same city.
steps: Open a listing; scroll the Similares row.

requirement: The seller card shows only recorded facts
expected: With fewer than 10 reviews the card leads with activity bucket, confirmed sales, Nuevo en Laria or En Laria desde, and Correo confirmado (Particular); no reply-time claim.
steps: Open their listings.

requirement: Tienda verificada explains what was checked
expected: Pressing the badge shows RUC, razón social, address, a phone on file, the verification date and what verification does not mean; works without scripts.
steps: Press Tienda verificada.

requirement: Back-in-stock alert fires once
expected: A signed-in buyer presses Avísame cuando vuelva on an Agotado listing; when stock returns they get one notification and one e-mail and the watch ends; visitors are sent to sign in; owners cannot watch their own.
steps: Watch it; restock it in Inventario; check Notificaciones and the e-mail queue.

requirement: A sold listing offers a similar-listing alert
expected: On a sold listing, Avísame si aparece otro creates an immediate search alert for its category, type and brand; pressing again says it exists.
steps: Press it twice; open Alertas.

requirement: The WhatsApp message says what and where
expected: The opening message names the title, price (when set) and the listing link and asks if it is available; stores are addressed as su.
steps: Press Contactar por WhatsApp; read the wa.me text.

requirement: Quick questions are optional and appended
expected: Four chips, none selected; chosen ones are appended to the message in order; hidden for Solicitar compra.
steps: Select two chips; press the button; read the text.

requirement: Contact opens WhatsApp at once
expected: The button is a link opening WhatsApp in a new tab immediately; the contact is recorded in the background and a failed record never blocks it.
steps: Press the button with the route down.

requirement: The safety sheet shows once at the right moment
expected: Before the first contact on a listing from S/ 1,000, or any Solicitar compra, a sheet with three tips shows once per browser; Continuar opens WhatsApp; cheaper listings go straight through.
steps: Contact each; contact the expensive one again.

requirement: Visitors get a gentle sign-in hint
expected: Signed-out visitors see Ingresa antes de escribir… above the button; signed-in users do not; contact never requires an account.
steps: Open a listing both ways.

requirement: Owners get shortcuts on their own listing
expected: The owner sees Es tu publicación with Editar, Bajar precio and Marcar vendida (confirmed, then the sale confirmation), or Ver en Inventario for stock-managed listings; nobody else sees it.
preconditions: Seller signed in on own listing
steps: Open the listing; use each shortcut.
spec_ref: functional-spec.md § Particular Dashboard and Dynamic Profile Data

requirement: Listing ids redirect to the slug
expected: /instrumentos/<listing id> redirects to /instrumentos/<slug>.
steps: Open it by id.

requirement: Pinch and double tap zoom the lightbox photo
expected: In the lightbox on a phone, pinching zooms up to 4x around the fingers; a double tap toggles 1x and 2.5x at the tapped point; dragging while zoomed pans and stops at the photo's edges.
steps: Open the listing, tap the photo, pinch out, drag to every edge, double tap twice.

requirement: Every zoom gesture has a button and a key
expected: Acercar and "Alejar" (44 px) step 1x to 4x and back; + and - do the same, 0 returns to 1x; the wheel and a trackpad pinch zoom at the pointer; a screen reader hears "Foto ampliada al 300 %".
steps: Open the lightbox; use the buttons, + / - / 0 and the wheel over a detail.

requirement: A swipe changes photo only at 1x and the zoom resets per photo
expected: At 1x a sideways swipe moves to the next photo; zoomed, the same swipe pans; changing photo by arrows, keys or swipe always shows the new photo at 1x.
steps: Swipe at 1x; zoom; swipe again; press Foto siguiente.

requirement: Moving between photos is instant and focus returns
expected: The next and previous photos are already loaded when the lightbox moves; the gallery's second photo is eager; closing the lightbox (Esc or Cerrar) puts focus back on the photo button that opened it; zoom glides are instant under reduced motion.
steps: Open the lightbox with Enter, move with arrows on a throttled network, press Esc; repeat with reduced motion on.

requirement: Compartir opens the phone's share sheet in one tap
expected: On a phone, Compartir opens the native sheet with the title, "<título> a <precio> en Laria" and the listing link.
preconditions: Listing page with ShareListing wired; Android or iOS
steps: Tap Compartir; choose WhatsApp.

requirement: Without a share sheet, a menu copies, opens WhatsApp or downloads the image
expected: On desktop Chrome, Compartir opens a menu: Copiar enlace (status "Enlace copiado", the link is on the clipboard), WhatsApp (wa.me with text and link) and Descargar imagen para estados (laria-<slug>.png); Esc closes it and returns focus.
preconditions: Listing page with ShareListing wired; desktop Chrome
steps: Press Compartir; try each option; press Esc.

requirement: Compartir imagen shares the story PNG on phones
expected: On a phone that can share files, Compartir imagen shares a 1080x1920 PNG of the listing with text and link (e.g. to WhatsApp Status).
preconditions: Listing page with ShareListing variant module; Android Chrome
steps: Tap Compartir imagen; choose WhatsApp > Mi estado.

requirement: A listing link shows its photo, title and price in WhatsApp
expected: The listing's og:image is /instrumentos/<slug>/opengraph-image: first photo, title, price, condition, Tienda verificada for verified stores, Vendido once sold; any failure gives the generic Laria card.
steps: Paste a listing link in WhatsApp; check og:image in the HTML; curl the image (PNG 200).

requirement: Every page and category link has a Laria preview
expected: / and pages without their own image show the 1200x630 Laria card; /instrumentos/<categoría> shows "<categoría> en Laria".
steps: curl og:image on /, /listados, /terminos and /instrumentos/guitarras; open each image.

requirement: The story image exists only for public listings
expected: /instrumentos/<slug>/historia returns a 1080x1920 PNG with Cache-Control public, max-age=300 for a public listing and 404 for a pending, hidden or unknown one.
preconditions: One public and one pending listing
steps: curl -I both URLs.

requirement: A signed-in buyer asks a public question on a published listing
expected: The question appears at once under Preguntas, newest first, with the asker shown as first name and initial.
preconditions: Published listing; signed-in buyer who is not its seller
steps: Open the listing, write a question in Haz una pregunta and send it; reload as a visitor.

requirement: Questions and answers refuse contact details
expected: A question or answer with a run of 6+ digits (spaces, dots or dashes ignored), a link or an e-mail is refused with the Spanish message; nothing is stored.
preconditions: Published listing; buyer and seller accounts
steps: Send a question with 987 654 321, another with www.ejemplo.com, another with an e-mail; as the seller answer with a phone number.

requirement: Asking is limited and never on one's own listing
expected: A 4th unanswered question by the same buyer on one listing and a 21st question in 24 hours are refused with their messages; the seller cannot ask on their own listing; pending and sold listings take no questions.
steps: Ask three questions, then a fourth; ask as the seller; call the ask action on a pending and a sold listing.

requirement: Only the seller answers, once
expected: The listing owner (or the store owner for a store listing) answers an unanswered question once; the answer shows to every later visitor as Respuesta de quien vende; another account, the asker or an admin cannot answer; a second answer is refused.
preconditions: Published Particular and store listings with questions
steps: As the seller press Responder and send; try again; try as another account.

requirement: The seller hears about a new question; the asker about the answer
expected: A new question creates one Te hicieron una pregunta notification and one queued e-mail (Responder opens /instrumentos/<slug>#preguntas); an answer creates one Respondieron tu pregunta notification and no e-mail. Ver detalle opens the listing at Preguntas.
preconditions: E-mail worker configured or delivery table visible
steps: Ask a question; check the seller's notifications and the delivery row; answer it; check the asker's notifications.

requirement: A question can be reported
expected: Reportar pregunta files a report with target question; a second open report by the same account is refused; the asker cannot report their own question; a hidden question cannot be reported.
preconditions: Published listing with a question by another account
steps: Press Reportar pregunta, choose a reason and send; repeat.

requirement: An admin hides and restores a question with a reason
expected: Ocultar with a reason removes the question for visitors (the admin still sees it tagged Oculta with the reason); Mostrar brings it back; both are in the admin audit; non-admins are refused.
preconditions: Admin account; listing with a question
steps: As admin press Ocultar, enter a reason, confirm; check as a visitor; press Mostrar.

requirement: Browser roles cannot touch the table directly
expected: anon can read through get_listing_questions only; anon cannot call the write functions; authenticated cannot select, insert, update or delete listing_questions; the asker cannot edit and the seller cannot delete.
steps: Run the SQL suite.

requirement: Signed-out visitors and sold listings see the right state
expected: Signed out: the Q&A and a quiet Ingresa para preguntar link that returns to #preguntas; empty: the empty-state sentence; sold: existing Q&A read-only with the sold note, and no section when there were none. No hydration warning.
preconditions: Published listing without questions; sold listing with and without questions
steps: Open each signed out and signed in at 390 px and desktop; check the console.

requirement: The question form gives instant, accessible feedback
expected: A too-short or contact-detail question shows the field error under the label without a request; the counter shows n / 300; success and server errors are announced and focused; every control is at least 24 px.
preconditions: Signed-in buyer on a published listing
steps: Send Hola; send a phone number; send a valid question; tab through with a screen reader.
